novelty_flags.label: Related work, comparator promise table, and Lemma causal-identification
novelty_flags.one_line: OrtizVillavicencioSantAnna2025 v3 Theorem 4.1 is the identification theorem, while asymptotic normality is Theorem 4.2; the proposal also cites nonexistent v3 locations “Theorem 3.2 and Corollary 3.1.”

novelty_flags.label: Related work, comparator promise table, known-reductions
novelty_flags.one_line: AkbariKiyavashGhassami2025 v3 Theorem 3 is repeated-cross-section identification, whereas the panel efficient influence function is Theorem 5; all theorem-number comparisons must be corrected.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem observable-equivalence
soundness_flags.one_line: Its reverse implication quantifies over an arbitrary observed P while requiring rank and spectrum of H, but H uses Psi and theta, and theta is only defined from a full-data Q whose existence is the conclusion.

soundness_flags.label: ass:no-anticipation
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited OVS v3 no-anticipation condition is a conditional-mean restriction, whereas the proposal labels the strictly stronger almost-sure potential-outcome equality as the standard cited condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:conditional-parallel-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: OVS v3’s DDD-CPT is period-by-period equality of one-step conditional mean changes; the proposal’s target-indexed long-difference equality is a different, weaker condition and cannot be tagged standard under that citation without explanation.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:canonical-gradient and thm:crossfit-attainment
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Conditional contrast covariance is restricted to fixed rank with uniformly separated positive spectrum; rank-changing laws are excluded.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The canonical bound and attaining estimator are claimed only on the fixed-rank separated staggered-DDD model.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:gap-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Inference for the optimized variance gap excludes the equality boundary through Delta(bcmp) >= delta0 > 0.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The Wald gap claim is only pointwise away from the equality boundary.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes observable staggered-DiD moment restrictions, derives covariate-dependent efficient weights, and gives an attaining efficient estimator for staggered DiD.
The paper studies conditional moment restrictions in censored and truncated regression models and derives semiparametric efficiency bounds and appropriately weighted attaining estimators.
The paper studies semiparametric two-step GMM with conditional-moment nuisance functions and efficiency of optimally weighted estimators.
The paper derives DiD efficiency results under compositional changes and a nonparametric Hausman-type comparison for compositional changes.

The paper develops robust efficient imputation for its event-study model and notes applicability to triple-difference designs, without establishing equivalence to the OVS conditional clean-comparison model.

Audit every theorem and equation anchor against the exact cited versions, especially OVS and Akbari–Kiyavash–Ghassami, and retag the stronger a.s. no-anticipation and long-difference parallel-gap assumptions as novel or replace them with the cited conditions.

Make the equality frontier a direct two-comparator result by naming OVS’s estimator and one external published DDD comparator in the proposition, with an explicit observable diagnostic and a generic-class strict-loss theorem beyond the binary witness.
